column1: # Skill DB Type, NoDamage and Ignore damage flags for every catalog skill, both
# modes. Extracted from the reference skill database (renewal and pre-renewal)
# at the pinned reference commit. Columns: id, name, renewal type, renewal
# no_damage, pre-renewal type, pre-renewal no_damage, renewal ignore flags,
# pre-renewal ignore flags. The ignore flags column lists the set ones among
# IgnoreDefCard, IgnoreElement and IgnoreFlee ("none" when none is set); every
# column is "-" when the mode has no row.
